name: Love
source:
The oldest of Vanessa's three daughters. She is currently working at a diner in the outskirts of the city. She suffers from hypersomnia and it is nearly impossible for anyone to wake her up because of it.

She is constantly looking for a relationship but something she keeps secret is stopping her from getting a boyfriend.
